audit.attrition: 75% classifiable and 80% power rules exist, but no attrition-adjusted calculation links them to 64 templates.
audit.blocking: 32 cells leave only two independent task-template pairs per cell.
audit.expected_variance: Absent for binary yield/failure and continuous timing estimands.
audit.interaction_analysis: No interaction power or precision demonstration; two templates per cell cannot establish stable cell-level uncertainty.
audit.minimum_detectable_effect: Thresholds (15% throughput, 0.10 yield) exist, but no design MDE calculation exists.
audit.multiplicity_models: No simulation demonstrates Holm-adjusted P1-P5 inference or mixed-model identifiability with planned operators.
audit.paired_design: Specified but no prospective within-pair variance supplied.

finding: The number is a design assertion, not a prospective power/precision justification. Convenience cannot resolve it.
primary_estimands: stage/type binding within repository x task-class strata
condition interactions by repository, task class, and difficulty
required_resolution: Specify variance, baseline rates, within-pair correlation, repository/task intraclass correlations, operator allocation, and plausible attrition ranges without study outcomes.
Run a prospective simulation or analytic precision/power calculation for conjunctive binding and interaction decisions.
Document sensitivity across defensible nuisance parameters and justify the frozen minimum effects.
If 64 is inadequate or excessive, issue a separately identified amendment and rerun every readiness condition before execution.
